intro: Smart design meets everyday convenience with the Senate. From easy-access shelves to hidden storage, every detail is made to help you create a space that feels stylish, tidy, and always put together.

features.title: A compact design made for modern homes
features.text: Small spaces deserve smart storage. Thoughtfully designed to fit urban homes, our media unit keeps things organised without taking up extra room.

features.title: Push-to-open drawers for effortless access
features.text: No clunky handles—just a gentle push opens smooth, hidden storage for remotes, accessories, and everyday essentials.

features.title: Open shelves that keep things within reach
features.text: Whether it’s books, media devices, or décor, open shelving gives you easy access while keeping your space looking neat and well-styled.

features.title: A dual-tone finish that works anywhere
features.text: The combination of warm wood and crisp white brings a balanced, modern touch to your home—effortless, stylish, and never out of place.

features.title: Built strong for everyday use
features.text: Designed to handle daily life, our unit is made from durable materials that keep it looking great, no matter how much you use it.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
